$comment: The public API contract: what each participating entry point commits to, checked both ways by scripts/check-api-contract.mjs. Bootstrapped from origin/main's committed reports plus the additions this branch made deliberately, each audited before this file was written — never read back from the current reports, because a list derived from its own output approves whatever drift produced it. Edit by hand, with a changeset saying what moved. Every surface is filed under one framework in `frameworks`: `neutral` for the packages under packages/shared, one key per binding folder under packages/ — an entry point names only surfaces of its own package's framework.
